rounds.name: Worker-Arden
rounds.text:
Withholding pay incentivizes the worker to complete more tasks even if they might cut corners, yielding 5 tasks versus 3 when trusted, and still gives at least 1 task if they cut corners. Since it dominates in both outcomes, the safe choice is to withhold.  
ACTION: WITHHOLD
